title: EXPLORE MICROSOFT
description: Paid 12-week summer internship for first- and second-year college students, where interns work in a small pod building real software with mentorship from Microsoft engineers.

title: UBER CAREER PREP
description: Free virtual program for CS undergrads with workshops, mock interviews, and 1:1 mentorship from an Uber engineer to help you land your first tech internship.

title: SEO TECH DEVELOPER
description: Free program for first-year and sophomore CS students with technical training, mentorship, and a paid summer residency (about $6,000) to prepare for top tech internships.

title: CODE2040 FELLOWS
description: 10-month career accelerator for Black and Latinx college students in tech, with mentorship, technical training, and support landing a paid summer internship.

title: KP ENGINEERING FELLOWS
description: Paid summer fellowship where students work as engineers at Kleiner Perkins portfolio startups, plus founder talks and a network of 1,000+ alumni.

title: NEO SCHOLARS
description: Program for top CS undergrads at US universities, offering mentorship from leading founders and engineers, a strong peer community, and fast-tracked startup recruiting.

title: SUMMER OF BITCOIN
description: Global remote summer program where university students contribute to Bitcoin open-source projects with mentors and earn a stipend paid in bitcoin.

title: DAAD RISE GERMANY
description: Funded summer research internships at German universities and institutes for undergrads from North America, the UK and Ireland. Most positions need no German.

title: MITACS GLOBALINK
description: 12-week research internships at Canadian universities for undergrads from Mitacs partner countries, working on real projects with faculty supervisors.

title: CERN OPENLAB
description: 9-week paid summer program at CERN in Switzerland for bachelor's and master's students in computing, working on ML, data, and high-performance computing projects.

title: NSF REU
description: Paid summer research programs at US universities for undergrads, usually with a stipend, housing, and travel covered. Hundreds of sites, many in computer science.

title: JANE STREET INSIGHT
description: Free multi-day program at Jane Street where students learn about trading, software engineering, and strategy, with travel and housing covered. No finance background needed.

title: CODEPATH
description: Nonprofit offering free virtual CS courses for college students, including a 10-week Technical Interview Prep course taught with engineers from top tech companies.

title: COLORSTACK
description: Free community for Black and Latinx CS students in the US and Canada, with career fairs, interview prep, mentorship, and access to internships.

title: REWRITING THE CODE
description: Free global community for women in tech with a 12-month fellowship offering coaching, networking, and internship opportunities at partner companies.
